macros.name: aftercolumnseparator
macros.doc: You can redefine \beforecolumnseparator and \aftercolumnseparator length to define spaces before or after the column separator, instead of letting eledpar calculate them automatically.

macros.name: AtBeginPairs
macros.doc: You can use the macro \AtBeginPairs to insert a code at the begining of each pairs environments.

macros.name: AtEveryPstartCall
macros.doc: The \AtEveryPstartCall argument is called when the \pstartL or \pstartR is called.

macros.name: beforecolumnseparator
macros.doc: You can redefine \beforecolumnseparator and \aftercolumnseparator length to define spaces before or after the column separator, instead of letting eledpar calculate them automatically.

macros.name: columnrulewidth
macros.doc: The width of the rule is \columnrulewidth (initially 0pt so the rule is invisible).

macros.name: Columns
macros.doc: The command \Columns typesets the texts in the previous pair of Leftside and Rightside environments.

macros.name: columnseparator
macros.doc: The macro \columnseparator is called between each left/right pair of lines.

macros.name: firstlinenum
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between succesive numbered lines.

macros.name: firstlinenum*
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between succesive numbered lines.

macros.name: goalfraction
macros.doc: When it thinks that the fraction \goalfraction of a page has been filled, it finishes that page and starts on the other side’s text.

macros.name: Lcolwidth
macros.doc: The lengths \Lcolwidth and \Rcolwidth are the widths of the left and right columns, respectively.

macros.name: ledsavedprintlines
macros.doc: Just in case, \ledsavedprintlines is a copy of the original \printlines.

macros.name: lineation
macros.doc: Lines can be numbered either by page, by pstart or by section; you specify this using the \lineation{⟨arg⟩} macro, where ⟨arg⟩ is either page, pstart or section.

macros.name: lineation*
macros.doc: Lines can be numbered either by page, by pstart or by section; you specify this using the \lineation{⟨arg⟩} macro, where ⟨arg⟩ is either page, pstart or section.

macros.name: lineationR
macros.doc: \lineationR{⟨word⟩} is the macro used to select the lineation system for right texts.

macros.name: linenumincrement
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between succesive numbered lines.

macros.name: linenumincrement*
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between succesive numbered lines.

macros.name: onlysideX
macros.doc: The \onlyXside and \onlysideX hooks for \Pages allow notes to be printed either in left or right pages only.

macros.name: onlysideX
macros.doc: The \onlyXside and \onlysideX hooks for \Pages allow notes to be printed either in left or right pages only.

macros.name: onlyXside
macros.doc: The \onlyXside and \onlysideX hooks for \Pages allow notes to be printed either in left or right pages only.

macros.name: onlyXside
macros.doc: The \onlyXside and \onlysideX hooks for \Pages allow notes to be printed either in left or right pages only.

macros.name: Pages
macros.doc: The command \Pages typesets the texts in the previous pair of Leftside and Rightside environments.

macros.name: parledgroupnotespacing
macros.doc: \parledgroupnotespacing can be redefined by the user to change the interline spacing of ledgroup notes.

macros.name: printlinesR
macros.doc: For footnotes from right side texts a special version is supplied, called \printlinesR, which incorporates \Rlineflag.

macros.name: Rcolwidth
macros.doc: The lengths \Lcolwidth and \Rcolwidth are the widths of the left and right columns, respectively.

macros.name: Rlineflag
macros.doc: The value of \Rlineflag is appended to the line numbers of the right texts.

macros.name: sidenotemargin
macros.doc: The \sidenotemargin defines the margin of the sidenote for either left or right side, depending on the current environment.

macros.name: sidenotemargin*
macros.doc: The \sidenotemargin defines the margin of the sidenote for either left or right side, depending on the current environment.

macros.name: sublinenumincrement
macros.doc: The \firstsublinenum and \sublinenumincrement macros correspondingly set the numbering scheme for sublines.

macros.name: sublinenumincrement*
macros.doc: The \firstsublinenum and \sublinenumincrement macros correspondingly set the numbering scheme for sublines.

envs.name: astanza
envs.doc: The astanza environment forms a chunk but you may want to have more than one stanza within the chunk.

envs.name: Leftside
envs.doc: The left text is put within the Leftside environment and the right text likewise in the Rightside environment.

envs.name: pairs
envs.doc: Numbered text that is to be set in columns must be within a pairs environment.

envs.name: Rightside
envs.doc: The left text is put within the Leftside environment and the right text likewise in the Rightside environment.
